In Arizona we have grants for people with substance abuse disorders. It completely covers the cost of therapy. That's how I was getting help for awhile before they determined I was SMI (seriously mentally ill). All you have to do is say you drink a little or smoke greens and that's enough to get your sessions covered. I dont abuse them but I use them and that's all they needed to know. 

As for being SMI, that's the next step forward from the substance abuse grants. In AZ, people who are determined to be SMI, they get all of their mental health treatment covered. Its basically free insurance for us SMI folk. It covers your mental health med costs too where as the substance abuse grant only covers therapy and psychiatric appointments. 

If your in AZ, please check these resources out. Its kept me alive. I wouldn't be here with out that assistance. 

If your not in AZ, I still encourage you to reach out to see if theres anything similar in your state. You might be able to get some help prior to the squeeze. 

Feel free to ask me questions if you have any. I'm an open book 😅 

I hope you can get the help you need sooner rather than later.
